title: One Leaky Feature Buys a Sharpe of 19
subtitle: Out of sample Sharpe, 2023-01 to 2026-08, top 100 Binance USDT pairs, 15 bps one way

rows.label: Forward return leak
rows.detail: Adds a 5 day forward return feature with the audit fail switch off; IC 0.724, max drawdown 2.5%

rows.label: Centered average leak
rows.detail: Adds an 11 day centered moving average ratio, which sees 5 bars ahead; IC 0.438, max drawdown 3.4%

rows.label: Delay 0
rows.detail: Trades at the same close the signal observed; IC 0.133

rows.label: Baseline ridge
rows.detail: 7 ranked features, weekly rebalance, delay 1; IC 0.125, max drawdown 29.7%

rows.label: 30 day momentum alone
rows.detail: No model, long the 30 day winners; IC -0.049

rows.label: 1 day reversal alone
rows.detail: No model, short the 1 day winners; IC 0.000

rows.label: Random scores
rows.detail: Negative control; IC 0.0005, so this is the cost of trading noise

caption: Every row passes through the same universe, CV, portfolio and cost model. The two leaky rows are what the pipeline produces when the leakage audit is told not to stop the run. Hover a bar for its IC and drawdown.
source: projects/leakage-checked-backtester/results/experiments.csv, column sharpe (3 decimals as in results/experiments_log.txt)
